summary: [Zendesk] objects: Tickets (CRUD + bulk create/update/destroy), Users, Organizations, Groups, Comments + Ticket Audits, SLA Policies, Satisfaction Ratings, Tags, Views, Macros, Ticket Fields. Lifecycle new->open->pending->hold->solved->closed. Base https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/. Cursor pagination (page[size]<=100); legacy offset capped 100 pages/10k records.
